Mod.Name: [Tsunamods] FF8 Gameplay Customizer
Mod.Author: Hobbitdur
Mod.Description:
► The ultimate gameplay tweaks ◄
This mods aims to bring lots of gameplay tweaks to FF8 and allow you to customize it to suit your preferences!
◆ Quality of life ◆ • DamageCapIncreased: Bring the damage cap up to 65.535. • NoMagicDepletion: Using magic doesn't decrease your stock. • DrawRework: Configure battle drawing, with separate Draw 100 options for field and world-map draw points. • NoUnequippedOnDream: Dream characters inherit their normal counterparts' full junction setups. • AP: Earn from 0 to 255AP. Thanks to Satan-fatalityz for funding part of this! • EXP: Earn from 0 EXP to x16 EXP. Thanks to Satan-fatalityz for funding part of this! • SaveAnywhere: Allow to save in any field, but keep a side save on normal save point to be sure.
◆ Game fix ◆ • BahamutRareItem: Fix rare item drop and mug probabilities. • TrueRandomness: Replace the lookup-table RNG with the system rand function. • GerogeroUncensoredCard: Restore Gerogero's uncensored card texture. • GerogeroUncensoredBattle: Restore Gerogero's uncensored battle textures.
◆ Special thanks ◆ • myst6re for Deling tool and RE work • Maki for his work on RE • DangerousDom and Nihil for testing • SlimeBucket for the preview

Enable Difficulty Balance options and update Squall can miss with the corrected Cronos patch.
